route: Law on Foreigners (Sl. glasnik RS 24/2018, 31/2019, 62/2023) art. 40(1): temporary residence may be granted on grounds including '10) vlasnistva nad nepokretnosti' (ownership of real estate) and '14) drugih opravdanih razloga'. Art. 43(1) general conditions: '2) dokaz o sredstvima za izdrzavanje tokom planiranog boravka; ... 4) dokaz o zdravstvenom osiguranju tokom planiranog boravka'. Stay up to three years, renewable (art. 44). Art. 40(4) lets the government set permits for digital nomads, investors and others by act. For permanent settlement (art. 70) 'dokaz o zdravstvenom osiguranju' is also needed.
policy: Law on Health Insurance (Sl. glasnik RS 25/2019, 92/2023) art. 11 and 16: the compulsory scheme (RFZO) insures employees, entrepreneurs, pensioners (including foreigners who get a pension only from abroad, items 25 and 26), foreign students and a few other groups. A non-working foreigner of working age on temporary residence is not on the lists I read, so the RFZO is not an option; RFZO's 'dobrovoljno osiguranje' is supplementary or travel cover (its travel policy 'ne moze se naruciti iz inostranstva' and covers stays of up to 90 days). In practice private cover is bought: Generali Srbija sells 'Zdravstveno osiguranje stranaca': sum insured 5,000 EUR a person, valid in Serbia only, outpatient care, drugs, X-ray, surgery, inpatient care up to 30 days; its page says the policy is needed to 'regulisati boravak'. No price published.

eu_citizen_difference: The law applies the same residence rule to foreigners generally; EU citizens have no S1/EHIC access to Serbian cover as residents. Not further checked.
uncertainty: No premium found. RFZO's own site was unreachable from this machine (the live site timed out; the Wayback copy loads); the Ministry of Interior's own text on which insurance meets art. 43 was not read. Insurers (Generali, Triglav, DDOR, Wiener) give prices only through quote tools. The Generali product (5,000 EUR) is likely the cheapest qualifying cover and probably far below a comprehensive policy.

statutory_must_pay.what: Nothing: the RFZO does not insure a non-working foreigner of working age on temporary residence (see the file's `policy`).

private_plan.product: voluntary private health insurance with out-patient and in-patient cover
private_plan.terms: GlobosMedic: out-patient (specialist, diagnostics) and in-patient (hospital, surgery) cover, about 800 network facilities, price depends on risks covered. Deductible not stated.
private_plan.pricing: Kurir (Mar 2024): prices 'from EUR 20' a month, varying with age and sex. A 2023 article seen in a search excerpt gives EUR 20-23 a month at ages 40-50 (URL not confirmed). EUR 21.50 x 2 = EUR 43 a month. Likely a floor for a mid-range plan.
